name: Medidata
description:
Medidata's MCP Connector for Claude provides two tools for Medidata users: Platform Help and Predictive Site Ranking. 

Platform Help allows users to query Medidata's platform documentation for answers about products like Rave EDC, Data Connect, and Clinical Data Studio. 

Predictive Site Ranking enables Intelligent Trials customers to predict which clinical trial sites align with enrollment goals during protocol planning, ranking sites based on indication, past performance, and various study criteria.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Medidata to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Medidata to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.imedidata.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Medidata MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Medidata provides these MCP tools: search_support_documentation, get_ranked_sites, and get_supported_disease_areas.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Medidata?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Medidata in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Medidata requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Medidata is developed by Medidata Solutions. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
